settings.passwordMismatch: New password and confirmation password do not match.
settings.passwordMinLength: New password must be at least 6 characters.
settings.serverDescription: IP listen address, port binding, and Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) origins
settings.proxyDescription: Configure outbound proxy (HTTP/SOCKS5) if the server requires firewall or WAF bypass
settings.engineDescription: Official API endpoint, PoW WASM solver URL, and client headers
settings.responsesStoreDesc: In-process cache backing previous_response_id. Entries are evicted after the TTL or when capacity is exceeded.
settings.searchModeDesc: Whether web search is enabled when the request omits web_search_options. Disabling strictly follows the OpenAI semantics and avoids injecting DeepSeek search system prompts.
settings.quotaDesc: Upstream mutes accounts after a few hundred requests per hour, and muting is delayed. Accounts that exhaust this budget are skipped until the window rolls over (0 = unlimited). Add more accounts instead of raising this value.
settings.hifDesc: Upstream expects the x-hif-leim risk-control token on completion requests (real clients poll it from hif-leim.deepseek.com). When disabled the header is not sent — this is for A/B experiments only, keep it enabled in normal use.
settings.startupHealthCheckDesc: Run one completion at startup to verify the account (the official client sends no message at startup). Disabling it matches the official startup sequence; account validity is still covered by a successful login + the mute early-check. For A/B experiments only.
settings.sessionPolicyDesc: per_request = new session per request, deleted when the stream ends (default, historical behaviour); reuse = keep and reuse the session per account to match the official client, but the reuse semantics are not yet verified with a real account — experiments only.
settings.sessionIdleSecs: Reused-session idle timeout (seconds, 0 = delete only on shutdown)
